title: Former DARPA man's 'hopeful monsters' hybrid proposal

tellings.quote:

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he met a former worker at DARPA, the US military's agency for advanced research, who described a project he once proposed that was never approved, which is why he felt free to talk about it. Michels says it was a hybrid proposal based on the work of a scientist named Richard Goldschmidt and his idea of 'hopeful monsters', sudden big leaps in how living things change. If true, it would show the military at least considered building new kinds of beings.
